question: Which of the following is a disadvantage of using contraceptive pills?

options.text: Both partners in a couple must take pills.
The effect of the pills is irreversible.

solution:
The correct answer is __**They may produce hormonal imbalance**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Conception: Fusion of the sperm and the egg to make a zygote.
 
• Conception leads to pregnancy.
 
• Contraception: Ways to prevent pregnancy.
 
• Contraceptive pills are taken orally to avoid unwanted pregnancy.

Explanation:

 
• The mechanism of action of the contraceptive pills is based on: Inhibiting ovulation.
 
• Contraceptive pills: Stop follicular development.
 
• They raise the level of progesterone in the body.
 
• Raised levels of progesterone: Leads to a negative feedback mechanism.
 
• It acts on the hypothalamus: Decrease the levels of Gonadotropin-Releasing Hormone.
 
• Mimics pregnancy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are multiple ways of contraception.
 
• Chemical, as well as physical contraceptives, are there.
 
• Physical contraceptives :
 
• Intra- Uterine Devices
 
• Condoms
 
• Cervical Caps
 
• Diaphragms
 
• Cervical sponge.
 
• Chemical contraceptives:
 
• Oral pills
